document.abstract: Recent advances in the field of “reliability engineering” include specialized work in four areas: equipment reliability, component reliability, design and use aspects and reliability program administration. The present status of equipment and part reliability is reviewed, and facts are given on measurement methods and their results. Reliability calculation and prediction are touched on.
